architectureDecisions: D1 — Export frozen LOCAL_VERIFIER_INHERITED_ENV and buildLocalVerifierEnvironment({parentEnv=process.env, env={}, platform=process.platform}={}) from local-command-verifier.js and index.js. Use environmentContract's exact 28 names. Copy BB-120 policy locally: no reverse agentic-system -> agent-tools import, shared package or migration. Existing agent-tools consumers import agentic-system; a reverse import creates a cycle. Literal allowlist: PATH, HOME, USER, LOGNAME, SHELL, TMPDIR, TEMP, TMP, LANG, LC_ALL, LC_CTYPE, TERM, TERM_PROGRAM, COLORTERM, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, XDG_STATE_HOME, USERPROFILE, HOMEDRIVE, HOMEPATH, APPDATA, LOCALAPPDATA, PATHEXT, SYSTEMROOT, COMSPEC, WINDIR.

D2 — Produce a fresh null-prototype map from own enumerable string-valued allowlisted parent keys, lexically sorted. Windows uppercases before membership/deduplication; first inherited variant wins. POSIX matches exact case. Apply own operator entries last; Windows normalizes them and later case variants win. Remove NODE_TEST_CONTEXT after merging (all Windows case variants). Omit missing names; never synthesize PATH/HOME or read credential/config files. Parent validation explicitly accepts parentEnv===process.env as the native exotic environment record; other injected maps are plain/null-prototype. Do not apply the operator-overlay plain-object test to native process.env. Inspect selected descriptors safely; never read non-allowlisted values or invoke accessors.

D3 — Add factory env={}; require a plain or null-prototype record. Reject null, arrays, non-plain objects, empty/'='/NUL keys, non-string values and NUL values with TypeError before verify/spawn. Validate even stripped NODE_TEST_CONTEXT entries. Copy/freeze own entries at construction. Explicit non-allowlisted grants and empty strings are valid; no coercion, null deletion or vendor auth inference.

D4 — Sample one filtered parent base per verify. Thread it into before/after gitState and win32 killTree/taskkill; force Git GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 last. Only executeProcess gets the frozen command overlay, built from that same base. Eliminate ambient process.env spreads and implicit child env defaults in this module. Command GIT_DIR/GIT_CONFIG_COUNT grants cannot redirect verifier identity checks or termination helpers.

D5 — Preserve shell:false, detached/platform behavior, windowsHide, ignored stdin, bounded capture, stream digests, summary limit and reason/result schemas. Revision mismatch rejects before command launch; exit-zero PASS, nonzero/spawn-error FAIL, timeout INCONCLUSIVE and tree-mutation FAIL precedence remain. requireUnchangedTree=true default and explicit false compatibility remain. Add no env dumps/values to records; existing trusted-command stdout capture is not a redaction guarantee.

D6 — Real host child/fixture tests plus injected POSIX/win32 maps cover casing, duplicate PATH variants, overlay precedence, missing names and own properties. Native Windows smoke is conditional and separately labelled; simulation cannot prove launch/kill. HOME/XDG/USERPROFILE/APPDATA preserve config compatibility and allow filesystem credential access.

D7 — Overlay is the local verifier factory API only. Existing Backend/QA, supervisor, deliver, MCP and re-grounding callers inherit restricted defaults automatically. Their agent env options are not verifier grants. Do not add CLI/task-schema forwarding here; callers constructing verifiers can supply env. Missing auth/proxy/build config requires a separately authorized grant, never restored ambient inheritance.

D8 — Use exact distinct literal negativeCaseBindings/testContract titles. Each negative test directly invokes its bound subject and asserts behavior, without skip/todo, env dumps or helper-only subject calls. Isolate or serialize synthetic planted variables and restore in finally; never inspect actual credentials.

D9 — Living docs document list/exports, command-only grants, precedence, channel stripping, casing and helper isolation, retaining trusted-command limits. BB-120 policy is delivered only when DONE. No Blackboard ids/research/value claims. Logs route by criterion/run to exact candidate and independent Jev.

D10 — Graph and plan researchBaselineSha are both 5386e2adee15a3175a5b6635b63a54f6e24128cb. Objective sources and source anchors materialize successfully at this baseline. Keep historical prototype source pins as historical evidence; no product implementation or upstream DONE claims are added.
implementationSlices: S1 — In local-command-verifier.js publish the frozen 28-name allowlist and pure environment builder with explicit POSIX/Windows rules; validate/copy the optional factory env overlay. Export list/builder through index.js. No new package or cross-package import. Native process.env is an allowed parent by identity despite its exotic prototype; injected maps/overlay remain plain or null-prototype. Descriptor-based selection reads only allowed parent values and rejects accessors before invocation, with copied immutable overlay.

S2 — Thread one filtered parent snapshot per verify into gitState, executeProcess and killTree. Only executeProcess gets the frozen command overlay. Force Git's GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 after the filtered base. Preserve revision/tree, shell:false, bounded evidence and lifecycle semantics. Thread base explicitly through gitState(root,base), executeProcess({...,env:commandEnv}) and killTree(child,base); commandEnv=buildLocalVerifierEnvironment({parentEnv:base,env:copiedOverlay}). No caller overlay reaches Git/taskkill. Snapshot includes own string allowlisted values only; Windows uppercase/deduplicate before overlay, POSIX exact case, NODE_TEST_CONTEXT stripped after overlay. Preserve original before-command HEAD mismatch rejection and post-command clean-tree comparison with identical reason/exit/stream hash grammar. Focused real basename Node launch using controlled PATH and Backend/QA accepted-SHA regression prove platform variables and identity semantics remain; missing PATH is deliberately omitted, not synthesized.

S3 — Add local-verifier-environment.test.js with distinct tests defined in testContract/negativeCaseBindings, invoking real verifiers against synthetic temporary Git repos plus pure injected-parent platform cases. Run BB-096 Backend/QA regression and both package suites after BB-120 delivery. E6 must import the verifier only after builtin wrappers are installed in a fresh child, avoiding the captured promisify(execFile) binding. E8 descriptor matrix rejects allowlisted accessor/nonstring and invalid overlay before effects; unknown parent values remain unread. Run actual child booleans, not environment dumps; native Windows evidence remains separate from the mandatory simulation. Port executed descriptorReplay cases through the actual product exports: native process.env, nonallowlisted throwing getter never read, allowlisted/overlay getters rejected without invocation, basename Node through retained PATH, filtered before/after Git helpers and preserved revision/tree/timeout. Historical weaker prototype behavior is not the selected contract.

S4 — Document exact inherited names, explicit factory overlay, no CLI forwarding and remaining home/network/filesystem trust in the two Living state files; run docs/export verification. Collect exact-candidate logs and criterion-specific evidence, then obtain independent Worker judgment under existing delivery controls.

environmentContract.precedence: allowlisted parent < validated copied command overlay < NODE_TEST_CONTEXT removal
environmentContract.parentSampling: Once per verify; command overlay copied at factory construction.
environmentContract.platformCases: win32 canonicalizes all emitted keys to uppercase and deduplicates case-insensitively. POSIX preserves exact casing.
environmentContract.compatibilityLimit: Non-allowlisted config/auth/proxy values need an explicit factory env grant; no CLI forwarding.
environmentContract.validation: Operator env and injected parent maps require Object.prototype or null prototype. Actual process.env is an explicitly allowed exotic parent record by identity; Node does not give it Object.prototype. Enumerate parent own names, select allowlisted key names first, then inspect those own descriptors without reading any non-allowlisted values. Reject selected accessors/non-string data values; never invoke getters. Overlay descriptors must all be own data strings, valid key/value without NUL/= or empty key; freeze copied null-prototype map. Win32 fold/deduplicate first, overlay last, strip NODE_TEST_CONTEXT after merge.
environmentContract.processCoverage: The primary verification child gets allowlisted base+explicit copied overlay. Git HEAD/tree/status integrity helpers and process-group cleanup get only filtered base, with Git forced GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1. taskkill gets filtered base without command overlay. No process launched by this verifier receives raw process.env.

testContract.title: BB-130 N1 parent-only synthetic secrets are absent
testContract.assertions: Plant both synthetic secret names in isolated parent; assert child booleans false and PASS, baseline true.

testContract.title: BB-130 N2 NODE_TEST_CONTEXT overlay cannot revive the parent channel
testContract.assertions: Parent and overlay marker valid strings; assert absent in real child/nested node:test.

testContract.title: BB-130 N3 malformed overlay is rejected before verification
testContract.assertions: Direct factory throws TypeError for null/array/non-plain, non-string own value, empty/'='/NUL key, NUL value. Empty strings/null-prototype are controls.

testContract.title: BB-130 N4 command overlay cannot redirect Git identity checks
testContract.assertions: Grant synthetic nonexistent GIT_DIR/GIT_CONFIG_COUNT only to command; child sees grants, actual Git helpers do not; correct revision PASSes.

testContract.title: BB-130 N5 revision mismatch fails before command side effects
testContract.assertions: Wrong 40-hex candidate: FAIL/REVISION_MISMATCH, actual revision and empty-stream digest; absent command sentinel.

testContract.title: BB-130 N6 mutating verifier remains TREE_MUTATED FAIL
testContract.assertions: Exit-zero append to fixture.txt: FAIL/TREE_MUTATED with before-revision evidence.

testContract.title: BB-130 E1 secret explicitly granted through env is available
testContract.assertions: Explicitly grant one synthetic secret, assert visible; another ungranted token stays absent.

testContract.title: BB-130 E2 arbitrary overlay and inherited override work
testContract.assertions: Non-allowlisted BB130_OVERLAY and synthetic HOME override reach child; inherited PATH retained.

testContract.title: BB-130 E3 caller mutation cannot change the copied overlay
testContract.assertions: Mutate caller's env after factory construction; child sees copied value. Include empty-string positive control.

testContract.title: BB-130 E4 Windows test channel aliases are stripped
testContract.assertions: Pure win32 parent/overlay maps with mixed-case NODE_TEST_CONTEXT produce no case-equivalent marker.

testContract.title: BB-130 E5 platform variables casing and missing keys
testContract.assertions: Injected POSIX/win32 maps: Path/SystemRoot/ComSpec, PATH/Path dedupe, overlay path, USERPROFILE/APPDATA/TEMP, HOME/XDG, unknown names, missing keys and prototype PATH. Real verifier launches Node basename using controlled PATH; boolean PATH/HOME and literal argv assertions.

testContract.title: BB-130 E6 internal process environments exclude secrets and command grants
testContract.assertions: Use an isolated child harness: install native-backed execFile/spawn wrappers and syncBuiltinESMExports BEFORE dynamically importing local-command-verifier.js, so its module-level promisify captures the wrapper. Then invoke actual factory/verify on real Git; record only helper env booleans, assert filtered Git and absent overlay/test channel. Restore builtins in finally. Separate vm.SyntheticModule win32 process/child facade exercises taskkill argument/options via actual copied module; label simulated Windows, not native launch evidence.

testContract.title: BB-130 E7 frozen list and builder are exported through package index
testContract.assertions: Index/module share frozen exact list/builder; invoke builder and factory, audit declared writes and absence of ambient env spreading/defaults in this module.

testContract.title: BB-130 E8 descriptor validation cannot execute accessors
testContract.assertions: Invoke builder on own enumerable accessor/non-string allowlisted parent descriptors and invalid overlays. Reject TypeError without calling getter; do not inspect non-allowlisted parent values. Plain/null-prototype string parent maps are positive controls. Positive real process.env parent must build and launch correctly even though Object.getPrototypeOf(process.env)!==Object.prototype; invalid non-plain injected maps reject.

Windows process.env names ignore case; implicit value conversion is deprecated. Require string overlay values and test platform casing explicitly.
